Axiom: The dispatched critic runs on a model no stronger than the artifact's author — default the worker tier (Sonnet-class), never a step up "to be thorough". The consumers of a spec are workers on cheap models; a spec that only a stronger model can parse is not fit for execution (`AX_READER_WITHOUT_SESSION_CONTEXT` carried from prose into tooling). The `understanding` and `implementation-autonomy` lenses ARE the weak model's strength — it surfaces exactly what a worker would trip on. Semantic depth beyond that is not the critic's job; it stays with external review.
